When I walked into the room, I found my friend sitting down with a child. (Please note, my friend is not married)When I saw her in my dream she was holding a beautiful baby boy. When I approached my friend, the baby boy that she was holding was not in her control. He kept fiddling around. He almost like a hyperactive child. Question: In my dream, I saw myself in a school, where I saw a couple of children coming out of classrooms wearing back uniforms on. As I was walking, I found myself walking towards this room. The buldingb was very quiet, it was not loud or noisy as most schools are. When I walked into the room, I found my friend sitting down with a child. (Please note, my friend is not married)When I saw her in my dream she was holding a beautiful baby boy. He had bright blonde and black hair. Black hair at the bottom, not very visible and blonde hair on the top, it was very bright. When I approached my friend, the baby boy that she was holding was not in her control. He kept fiddling around. He almost like a hyperactive child. I put my hands forward to pick him up, when i picked him up, i held him for a couple of seconds, and then i gave him back to my friend. Once i gave him back, he fell asleep really quickly. I know this sounds weird brother, but please help me with the meaning of this dream. Ps.. I have sent you a couple of questions before too. Please could you get back to me about those and could you also make sure my answers are written back to me in english? Answer ID: 22097 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 892/D=176/k=1431) Dream is not an religious authority. Neither each dream has particular meaning. The worldly glitters and thoughts which lingers in the mind sometime occur in dream as an event. It may be understood by this dream that turning towards the love of worldly glitters, wealth and children wholeheartedly that causes negligence from akhirah is harmful. زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاء وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْقَنَاطِيرِ الْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالأَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِ ذَلِكَ مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَاللّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الْمَآبِ [آل عمران : 14] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
